authorized_current_source.method: Direct official settlement prices transformed as 100 minus compounded TONA

blocker.summary: Three-month TONA Futures do not exist for the full historical window. TFX launched the product on 2023-03-20.

official_evidence.context: The product was introduced as a compounded-TONA/RFR instrument after the JPY LIBOR transition.

blocker.implication: A 2018-2022 backfill would require a predecessor instrument such as Euroyen/LIBOR-linked futures or another benchmark family. That would violate the current homogeneous-basis and same-instrument-family Temporal PIT contract unless separately reclassified and validated.

decision.next_safe_option: Revisit only under a separately versioned methodology that explicitly models and validates the benchmark transition; do not silently splice legacy Euroyen/LIBOR pricing into TONA history.
